answer: The ferrous is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the reef. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length. By the pigment of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
